meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会跳过 OneCLI 网关,直接从 .env 读取 Anthropic 的 API Key 或 OAuth 令牌,注入容器环境变量,让 Claude 客户端用它访问 API。
howto.when: 当你想用 .env 管理 Anthropic 凭据、不用 OneCLI 网关时;实际生效需 .env 里设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 并重启服务。

say.text: 改用 .env 里的凭据,不走 OneCLI 网关
say.note: 会开启原生凭据代理并重启。

say.text: 帮我把 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 注入容器
say.note: 配置 API Key 并写入 .env。

say.text: 我要用 Claude 订阅令牌,不用 API Key

howto.what_en: When enabled, NanoClaw bypasses the OneCLI gateway and reads the Anthropic credential (API key or OAuth token) from .env, injecting it into the container as standard environment variables for the Claude Agent SDK. With the flag off, the gateway path is unchanged and the proxy is a no-op.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants simple .env-based credentials instead of the OneCLI vault; concretely, it takes effect when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env and the service is restarted.

say_en.text: Switch to using the credentials from .env instead of the OneCLI gateway.
say_en.note: Enables the native proxy and restarts.

say_en.text: Inject my ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from .env into the container.
say_en.note: Writes the API key path and restarts.

say_en.text: I want to use my Claude subscription token, not an API key.
